source.organization: Ministry of Justice of Ukraine via data.gov.ua
source.attribution: Ministry of Justice of Ukraine — EDR (data.gov.ua)

parsing.notes: ZIP -> UO.xml (3.1 GB, windows-1251). STREAM <SUBJECT> elements (SAX/iterparse) — do NOT load fully. Decode windows-1251; unescape "/'. Split REGISTRATION/TERMINATED_INFO on ';'. Resource UUID changes per refresh — resolve latest from the data.gov.ua dataset. Redact person names. NO address/KVED in the open export.

mapping_rules.status: Map STAN: зареєстровано->active, в стані припинення->in_termination, припинено->terminated.
mapping_rules.vat_id: Not available (no separate VAT number); TAX_PAYER_TYPE flags tax registration.

fixture_requirements: active LLC (ТОВ) with founders + beneficiaries + signers + capital

live_test_plan.smoke: Stream the first 1000 <SUBJECT> records from UO.zip; parse fields; assert EDRPOU + OPF + STAN.
live_test_plan.full: Weekly: stream the full UO.xml to NDJSON keyed on EDRPOU; redact PII.

blockers: PERSONAL DATA (founders/officers/beneficial owners) — redaction + lawful basis required.
No registered address / KVED in the open export (wartime reduction).
